question: A 42-year-old woman presents with trouble focusing. She says that she has trouble focusing on simple tasks and her thoughts are very scattered. These difficulties have been present since she was a young student in elementary school. She says she had difficulty focusing both at school and at home. The patient is diagnosed with a psychiatric condition and is prescribed the medication that is recommended as the first-line treatment. Which of the following statements is true regarding this new medication?

options.opa: “Appetite suppression is a common side effect of this medication.”
options.opb: “Bupropion is less effective in adults with this disorder than this medication.”
options.opc: “Chronic use of this medication can lead to tardive dyskinesia.”
options.opd: “Hypotension is a common side effect of this medication.”
options.ope: “Sedation is a common side effect of this medication.”
